A '''Hive Mother''' ruled the [[Roche system]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]]. During the [[Blockade of the Roche system]], the [[Hive Mother]] was taken prisoner by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and forced to remain in her quarters under guard so that the Empire could control the [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
